==About==

A {{i|Harvest Moon}} is the product of a second growth stage, second tier {{i|Pumpkin}} Harvest. Right-clicking a Harvest Moon and selecting "Slice" will give you 4x {{i|Pumpkin Flesh}} and 10x {{i|Seeds of Pumpkin}}. A Harvest Moon can be stored in a {{i|Stockbin}}.
